verdict.rationale: The evidence shows FireHydrant can automatically create Jira tickets as part of incident automation, and runbooks can attach task lists to incidents. Its retrospectives feature supports structured post-incident reviews. None of these items explicitly covers post-incident follow-up action items, tracking them to completion, or keeping their status synced with an issue tracker. Missing for 10: explicit follow-up/action-item tracking in retrospectives, completion status tracking, bidirectional issue-tracker sync of follow-ups, independent corroboration.
